projectDescription: A single-host system diagnostics TUI for macOS and Linux with twelve tabs covering CPU, memory, disks, processes, GPU, power, services, networking, a session Timeline scrubber, and a plain-English Insights anomaly engine.
keyFeatures: Twelve diagnostic tabs: Overview, CPU, Memory, Disks, Filesystems, Processes, GPU, Power, Services, Network, Timeline, and Insights
Plain-English Insights tab with heuristic anomaly detection (swap thrash, runaway processes, disk full, memory pressure, high load, zombie parties)
Session-wide Timeline scrubber — rewind every panel to any point in the current session
Cross-platform: macOS (Apple Silicon + Intel) and Linux, no system dependencies beyond Rust
Transparent about platform limits — shows what requires sudo without faking or prompting
Shared netwatch-sdk parsers for disk IO and network interface counters
Optional NVIDIA GPU stats (gpu-nvidia feature) and SMART disk health (smart feature)
Low CPU overhead — targets <0.5% at idle with a configurable tick rate
publicApiSurface: syswatch — default 1 Hz tick, starts on Overview tab
syswatch --tick <ms> — set fast-loop refresh interval in milliseconds
syswatch --tab <name> — start on a named tab (overview, cpu, memory, disks, fs, procs, gpu, power, services, net, timeline, insights)
Keys 1-9, 0, -, + — jump directly to any of the twelve tabs
↑ / ↓ — select row in Procs and Services tabs
s — cycle sort order in Procs (cpu, rss, io, start, name) and Services (name, status, pid)
← / → — scrub session backward / forward in Timeline
Home / End — jump to oldest sample or return to live
